SELECT SAFDS_ID, SAFDS_Name, SAFDS_ModelAndNumber, SAFDS_Remarks, SAFDS_Sent_Quantity, SAFDS_Owe_Quantity FROM FHGL_Shipping_Application_Formal_Details
SAFDS_SANID = #{SAN_ID}

SELECT a.SAFDS_ID , a.SAFDS_Name as 'Cy_Name', a.SAFDS_ModelAndNumber, a.SAFDS_Remarks, a.SAFDS_SANID, a.SAFDS_Sent_Quantity as 'CSDS_Storage_Quantity', a.SAFDS_Owe_Quantity, a.SAFDS_Sort as 'Cy_Sort', b.Csd_CyID as 'Cy_ID', b.Csd_Category as 'Cy_Category', b.Csd_ModelAndNumber as 'Cy_ModelAndNumber', b.Csd_CyUnit as 'Cy_Unit' FROM fhgl_shipping_application_formal_details a, yz_xsgl_contract_standard b, fhgl_shipping_application_formal c WHERE b.Csd_CyName = a.SAFDS_Name and c.SAFL_ODYContractID = b.Csd_CtID and c.SAFL_SANID = a.SAFDS_SANID and a.SAFDS_SANID = #{SAN_ID}

SELECT a.Cy_ID as 'Cy_ID', b.ASOY_ID, b.ASOY_Sort as 'Cy_Sort', ASOY_Category as 'Cy_Category', b.ASOY_Name as 'Cy_Name', b.ASOY_ModelAndNumber as 'Cy_ModelAndNumber', b.ASOY_Unit as 'Cy_Unit', b.ASOY_Quantity , b.ASOY_SANID, b.ASOY_Sent_Quantity as 'CSDS_Storage_Quantity' , b.ASOY_Owe_Quantity FROM yz_ckgl_commodity a, fhgl_shipping_application_ordinary b WHERE a.Cy_Name = b.ASOY_Name and b.ASOY_SANID = #{SAN_ID}
